# Testing (AP-TST)

[Back to catalog](index.md)

## AP-TST-01

**Skipped or ignored tests** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-12.

**Why it hurts.** Skipping tests to make a gate pass hides regressions.

**Fix.** Fix the test or the code; if a skip is legitimate and pre-existing, waive with the issue link.

**Detection:** files `*.cs`; pattern `\[(Fact|Theory|Test|TestMethod)\s*\([^)]*\bSkip\s*=|\[Ignore\b|\[Skip\b`.

## AP-TST-02

**Brittle markup snapshots** — severity **minor**, manual review (G7), principles P-12.

**Why it hurts.** Snapshotting full Radzen markup breaks on every Radzen upgrade.

**Fix.** Assert behaviour (text, state, callbacks) unless snapshots are the repository convention.

## AP-TST-03

**Deleted tests** — severity **blocker**, automated (tool), principles P-12.

**Why it hurts.** Removing tests in a feature change hides regressions.

**Fix.** Restore them or record an approved reason.

**Detection:** scanner: git diff deleted *Test*.cs files.
